description: PERF4 page part: index.html (frame governor, hold of the first paint until the map library has run, immediate boot, early glyph warm).  Sorts after PG-zperf3.

patches.repl:
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
  <script>
  // PERF4 frame governor.  For the first 6 s of a page the animation-frame callbacks of one frame (the map's style load, the map's render, the card placer, the engine) may not
  // use more than 20 ms together: the next callback waits for the next frame (at most two frames).  Three callbacks of 45 + 60 + 40 ms used to share one frame and were one
  // task of 150 ms; now they are three tasks.  Order is kept, nothing is dropped, cancelAnimationFrame works on the ids handed out here, and after 6 s the page's own
  // requestAnimationFrame is used as it is.
  (function () {
    var raf = window.requestAnimationFrame, caf = window.cancelAnimationFrame;
    if (!raf || !caf || !window.performance) return;
    var END = 6000, BUDGET = 20, seq = 0, live = {}, curT = -1, t0 = 0;
    function now() { return performance.now(); }
    window.requestAnimationFrame = function (cb) {
      if (now() > END) return raf.call(window, cb);
      var id = 1000000000 + (++seq), rec = { n: 0, h: 0 };
      function go() {
        rec.h = raf.call(window, function (t) {
          var n = now();
          if (t !== curT) { curT = t; t0 = n; }
          if (rec.n < 2 && n - t0 > BUDGET && n < END) { rec.n++; go(); return; }
          delete live[id]; cb(t);
        });
      }
      live[id] = rec; go(); return id;
    };
    window.cancelAnimationFrame = function (id) { var r = live[id]; if (r) { caf.call(window, r.h); delete live[id]; } else caf.call(window, id); };
  })();
  </script>
patches.note: First 6 s: the animation-frame callbacks of one frame share a 20 ms budget; the next one waits a frame.  Measured on the 4x phone: the map's style load (45-60 ms), the map's first render (60-70 ms) and the card placer (40-60 ms) were three callbacks of ONE frame, one long task of 150-190 ms; they are three tasks of 40-70 ms.  Together with the other PERF4 patches the median blocking time of / went from 554 to 204 ms (interleaved n=8, tmp/r1e/tbt.mjs).

patches.note: PERF2's glyph warm, cut into tasks of its own and moved from 3.2 s after load to the start of the page: the first layout of the app was 98-126 ms (60 of them first-use shaping of the system faces) and is 54-60 ms.  The same canvas also shapes, one face per task, the strings that the first open of the phone's Tools sheet lays out (read from the DOM of the open sheet): that first open was 240-264 ms by event timing at 4x (the second 64-120) and is 120-144 ms (n=6, interleaved).
